title: ‘Utterly Unacceptable’: Burnham Condemns Polish Airspace Incursion Alongside EU Leaders
text: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham strongly condemned the reported incursion into Polish airspace, describing the incident as “utterly unacceptable” during a joint appearance with European Union leaders. The remarks came amid heightened security concerns in Europe following a missile-related incident in Poland that has further strained relations with Moscow. Standing alongside European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen and European Council President Antonio Costa, Burnham emphasized the need for stability, security and coordinated action in response to threats facing the region.
